model_name: Hybrid Capacity & Schedule-Risk Engine (SimPy DES + OR-Tools CP-SAT + Quantile GBDT)
intended_use: Non-GMP technical decision-support prototype for QC Project Management: predictive instrument skid leveling, sample-arrival risk forecasting, and milestone delivery probability estimation on synthetic biologics operations.
out_of_scope: Autonomous schedule commitment without human QA/PM sign-off.
Official batch release date setting or regulatory disposition.
Trained exclusively on synthetic data (SYNTHETIC - NOT GMP DATA).

turnaround_vs_baselines.vs_last_observed: tie_statistically_indistinguishable (Delta = +0.0558h, 95% CI [-0.1599, 0.2709]h; q50 pinball Delta = +0.0279, CI [-0.0799, 0.1355])

benchmark_results.arrival_slip_vs_baselines: tie_statistically_indistinguishable across mean, median, and last-observed (fat-tailed upstream shocks unobservable from lot metadata alone)

optimizer_comparison.cpsat_value_proposition: Matches strong EDD heuristic on tardiness while generating explainable move reasoning traces and provable infeasibility diagnostics.

schedule_calibration_100_scenarios.independent_stress_simulator: Weibull machine breakdowns (k=2.2, lambda=90h), preemption, and absence shocks
schedule_calibration_100_scenarios.scientific_boundary: Agreement with an independent simulator is necessary but not sufficient evidence of real-world validity.
schedule_calibration_100_scenarios.honest_recalibration_finding: Isotonic recalibration reduces point Brier score from 0.1167 to 0.1112, but 95% cluster bootstrap CIs overlap.

known_failure_modes: Unmodeled multi-skid maintenance shutdowns degrade point arrival forecasts.
On sample-arrival slippage, heavy-tailed upstream bioreactor shocks prevent GBDT from beating simple mean; rolling-origin conformal interval is required for honest uncertainty bounds.
Small-sample projects with fewer than 5 historical batches rely heavily on global stream priors.
CP-SAT solver reports INFEASIBLE if total fixed commercial/contractual lot hours strictly exceed physical skid capacity.
negative_or_mixed_results: On sample-arrival slippage, point predictions achieve MAE 1.152d vs 1.110d for naive mean (-3.8% improvement), statistically tied across all baselines. On turnaround time, point MAE ties the last-observed baseline (Delta = +0.056h, CI [-0.160, 0.271]h). On schedule calibration, isotonic recalibration provides modest point improvement with overlapping CIs.
